explanation: The planner treated the business name as a caption rather than part of the logo, so text-overlay added a gray band that violated the plain-white background and separated the name from the sprout. The catalogue's misleading claim that image models cannot render legible text steered it toward this unsuitable tool; the complete short-name logo should have been generated together.
better_chain: image (generate a square flat logo with a simple green sprout directly above clearly readable 'Little Sprout', balanced spacing, entirely white background, no panel or mockup; use qwen-image-2.1 for strong lettering) → check (verify exact name, sprout placement, plain white background, and flat square logo)

steps.issue: Appropriate tool and settings for the sprout artwork: a square, flat green icon on white with space below. Generating only the icon was locally sound, although the overall split workflow was unsuitable.

The correct source image and exact name were supplied, but a plain caption-band tool was unsuitable for integrated logo lettering. Its gray panel broke the white-background requirement, and bottom placement left excessive separation.

missing: An integrated mark-and-name design preserving an entirely white background; a final check for the background and compact logo layout.
